maddeler.e: جَنْك or جُنْك • (jank or junk) m (plural جُنُوك (junūk))
maddeler.t: From Persian چنگ (čang, “harp”), from Middle Persian [script needed] (čang, “harp”), from which earlier already borrowed صَنْج (ṣanj, “harp; cymbal”).

g: jong, junk (flat Southeast Asian ship with two to three masts and square bows)
